title: October 30 reported short shares fell 11.74% and remain below the structural gate
mechanism: Reported short exposure declined after the prior increase, weakening one structural mechanism required for a nonlinear squeeze. The fresh delayed report remains below the Watch’s 20% outstanding-share gate and does not establish live covering.
observations: 42,393,750 shares were reported short at October 30 versus 48,031,618 at October 15, a decline of 5,637,868 shares or 11.74%.
Using 504,500,990 displayed shares outstanding, reported short exposure is about 8.40%; provider float estimates produce roughly 9.11% to 10.06%.
The November 10 publication is fresh under the 15-day rule at this November 11 observation, but it remains delayed and is not direct covering evidence.
stateEffect: Weakens the short-pressure engine without changing Dormant/Low. Reported exposure is fresh but falling and below the 20% structural threshold; unavailable live borrow/options/market mechanisms remain decisive limits.
